name: gtg
description: Todo list and handoffs for AI. Say 'gtg' and the agent writes a handoff a fresh session can resume from. Say 'gtg <project>' next time and it carries on from the next action. Extend it with your own subcommands and after-handoff steps in .gtg/.

interface.shortDescription: Pause and resume work without losing context
interface.longDescription: Checkpoint active work, write a durable handoff, and resume it cold from a later Codex session.
